quotes.text: Bend both knees to move down until the back knee lightly contacts the floor.
Keep the trunk upright and allow yourself to shift very slightly toward the front leg naturally, but keep the front shin approximately vertical in the bottom.
Reverse the motion until the front knee is approximately straight.

The farther forward the front foot, the more the exercise will rely on the posterior chain and stretch the rear hip flexors; the farther back the front foot, the more the exercise will rely on the quads.

Sets of 5-10 reps are usually appropriate with weight that allows a smooth movement and no crashing into the bottom position.
